waves.name: MAINJOB batch chain
waves.rationale: One job, one driver program and two subprograms with a single entry point. They share no dataset or copybook, so one wave is the whole system. Splitting it would cut the only call chain and give a wave with no testable boundary.
waves.unblocks: Nothing in the tree depends on it. It does prove the toolchain and the equivalence harness for any larger batch system the client has not supplied.
